system.description:
Also at 4th level, you’ve gained a bit of a reputation for your actions and attitudes. Choose from the following reputations and their benefits:

Buscadero: A trouble-maker; you’ve got a reputation for brawling, drinking, and gambling. Gain proficiency in all gaming sets, and you may always use your Intelligence or Charisma for any gambling check. In addition, you gain expertise in deception and sleight of hand checks made to cheat.

Outlaw: Well known as a dangerous gunslinger, you gain proficiency in intimidation, and you may always use Dexterity to make intimidation checks. If you have failed an intimidation check while you have a weapon hidden on your person, you may reveal the weapon to reroll the intimidation check.

White Hat: Well known as a hero of the people, you gain proficiency in persuasion. In addition, when making persuasion checks against guards and other law enforcers, as well as law-abiding civilians, you may add an expertise die.
